definition.comparable_scope: all C88 inclusion-matrix ordered pairs, including reflexive pairs
definition.delay: D_ij=T_j-T_i, with conditional law P(D=d | T_i=t)
definition.joint_survival: S_ij(k,l)=# {T_i>k and T_j>l} from C90, with C88 marginal boundaries at -1
definition.random_object: uniform permutation of the sixteen frozen C88 labels
definition.target_time: T_i=min{k:H_i is hit by the first k labels}
definition.trivial_target: C88 target 0 has T_0=0 for every permutation
